name: ATH Vouchers for ACS Courier – Shipping Labels
author: ATHPlugins

sections.description:
ATH Vouchers for ACS Courier connects your WooCommerce store to your ACS Courier account. You create the voucher from the order, print the label and hand the parcel over, without typing the address again in the courier’s own program.

What it does

  • A voucher box on every order: create the voucher, print the label, cancel it, or add a second parcel.
  • A column in the orders list that shows the voucher number, with a one-click “Create voucher” button.
  • Bulk actions in the orders list: create vouchers for many orders and print all their labels together.
  • Cash on delivery is filled in from the order’s payment method.
  • Voucher defaults you set once: weight, services, comments and label format, where the courier supports them.
  • A list of every voucher the plugin created, with its status.
  • A connection test, tools and an activity log for when something does not work.
  • English and Greek built in. Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

What you need

A business account with ACS Courier and the web service (API) credentials they issue for it. The plugin does not work without them.

Pro version

A separate paid plugin, ACS Courier for WooCommerce, adds automation (vouchers created by order status, parcels followed in the background, order statuses updated on delivery), tracking for your customers in emails and in their account, and support by email. It uses the same settings and vouchers as this plugin. Details: athplugins.com/plugins/acs-courier

Everything described under “What it does” is in the free plugin and stays in it.

Who makes it

ATHPlugins is the plugin studio of ATH Development, a web agency in Greece that builds and looks after WooCommerce stores. The plugins come out of that everyday work with real shops.

Trademark

ACS Courier is a trademark of its owner. This plugin is made by ATHPlugins.com and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by ACS Courier.

External services

This plugin sends data to ACS Courier’s web service in order to do its job. It contacts the service only when you create, print, cancel or check a voucher, or test the connection. What is sent: your ACS Courier account credentials, and for each voucher the recipient’s name, address, phone number and email, the parcel weight, the cash on delivery amount and the order number. No data is sent anywhere else.

The service is provided by ACS Courier: www.acscourier.net
Terms of service: www.acscourier.net/el/plirofories/xrisimes-plirofories/ethnikes-adeies-iso-oroi-kai-ypoxrewseis-taxymetaforas
Privacy policy: www.acscourier.net/el/plirofories/xrisimes-plirofories/delose-aporretou-acs-gdpr

Addresses the plugin calls: https://webservices.acscourier.net.

Nothing is sent while the plugin is only installed and activated: a call happens only after you enter your account details and use one of the actions above.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the Plugins screen and activate it. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Open WooCommerce > ACS Courier > Connection, enter the credentials ACS Courier gave you and save.
  3. Press the connection test on the same tab.
  4. Open Voucher defaults and set the weight and the options you use most.
  5. Open an order and press “Create voucher” in the ACS Courier box.
sections.faq:
Where do I get the credentials?

From ACS Courier. Ask your account manager or your local branch for web service (API) access for your business account.

Can I create vouchers for many orders at once?

Yes. Select the orders in the WooCommerce orders list and choose the bulk action.

Does it create vouchers automatically?

Not in this plugin. Automatic vouchers, automatic tracking and customer tracking are in the separate Pro plugin.

Does it work with the block checkout and with High-Performance Order Storage?

Yes.

Something failed. Where do I look?

Open the Tools tab. The activity log shows the last calls that failed and what ACS Courier answered.
